answer: A farm of 340 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in opal, queued in plume, and vine publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 33 identities per epoch. A farm of 2495 identities would post 3553 proofs and burn roughly 89 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
